title: Virtual retracts in groups acting on rooted trees
summary: We study virtual retracts in groups acting on rooted trees. We show that finitely generated branch groups do not have the local retraction (LR) property. Furthermore, we specialize to iterated monodromy groups of post-critically finite quadratic complex polynomials and show that the (LR) property characterizes, among post-critically finite quadratic complex polynomials, those with a euclidean orbifold, i.e. the powering map and the Chebyshev polynomial.
